The opposition stop, the presumption boundary, the immigration, juvenile and federal boundaries and the three release blockers on the December 2026 statute versions are untouched. Counsel adoption of the branch and the acceptable agreement evidence is recorded as an open legal question.

The VF01 hold on SELF_HELP_STOP is not reclassified here: it is answered on the record but the packet still prints the blanket stop, so it stays until the repair lands and is re-read.
